customManagers.description: Version pins annotated with '# renovate:' in Ansible group_vars

packageRules.description: Keep required_version a compatibility floor (OpenTofu releases lag Terraform's numbering)
RKE2 versions carry a +rke2rN build suffix. Kubernetes upgrades one minor at a time, so propose each minor separately
Stay on Helm 3 until kubernetes.core/helm-diff are validated against Helm 4
Rancher 2.15.x requires Kubernetes < 1.37; raise this with the Rancher pin
Rancher's own charts follow its minor (110.x is Rancher 2.15); raise this with the Rancher pin

Minor and major platform updates need a human decision on compatibility and upgrade order. Patches automerge after the E2E workflow deploys them on the runner. The manual-review label (replacing the automerge one the patch/minor rules set) is what the shared preset's PR note and the PR list read
